hero.subtitle: Bringing people back
hero.title: Together
hero.text1: The age of getting home to your Wii U and hopping on Minecraft with your friends is over.
hero.text2: Samtendo Network is a project that aims to fix that problem by reviving now defunct online servers for the 3DS and Wii U.

aboutUs.title: About us
paragraphs: Samtendo Network is a mostly open-source project that aims to recreate Nintendo Network for the 3DS and Wii U using clean-room reverse engineering.
We are a small team of volunteers who work on this project in our free time. However, our one aim is to bring people back to the couch on Mario Kart 8.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.text: Here are some common questions we're asked for easy information.

QAs.question: Will my existing NNIDs work on Samtendo?
QAs.answer: Sadly, no. Existing NNIDs will not work on Samtendo, as only Nintendo holds your user data; while an NNID-to-SNID migration is theoretically possible, it would be risky and require sensitive user data we do not wish to hold.

QAs.question: What consoles do you support?
QAs.answer: As of April 2026, we only support the Nintendo 3DS family of systems. However, support for Wii U is planned to start in late May.

QAs.question: Do you know when feature/service will be ready?
QAs.answer: No. Lots of Samtendo's features/services are developed independently (for example, Miiverse may be worked on by one developer while Accounts and Friends is being worked on by another) and therefore we cannot give an overall ETA for how long this will take.

QAs.question: When will you add more games?
QAs.answer: We work on new games once we feel that our backend libraries are ready to support it, and there is developer time available to maintain it. A lot of our work goes into stabilising and completing our existing games - we want to get the best experience possible in those before we move on to new titles. Since new work comes up all the time, we cannot make any estimate of when that would be.

QAs.question: Will Samtendo support the Wii/Switch?
QAs.answer: The Wii already has custom servers provided by Wiimmfi. We currently do not wish to target the Switch as it is both paid and completely different to Nintendo Network.

QAs.question: Will I need hacks to connect?
QAs.answer: Yes, you will need to hack your console to connect. You can do so here for 3DS and here for Wii U.

QAs.question: If I am banned on Nintendo Network, will I stay banned when using Samtendo?
QAs.answer: We do not have access to Nintendo Network's bans, so all Nintendo Network users are not banned. However, we also have rules to follow when using the service and failing to follow these rules could result in a ban.

QAs.question: Can I use cheats or mods online with Samtendo?
QAs.answer: Only in private matches - gaining an unfair advantage or disrupting the online experience with people who didn't consent (as in public matches) is a bannable offence. We regularly apply account and console bans to both Wii U and 3DS systems. Samtendo uses extra security measures that make traditional 'unban' methods like changing your serial number ineffective.

delete.modalDescription:
Are you sure you want to delete your PNID? Please consider the following before deletion:

Your account data across all Samtendo Network services (this includes Forum and Juxtaposition) will be erased.
Your Stripe data and subscription will be automatically deleted.
You will not be able to use the same PNID on a new account in the future.
Deleting an account does not solve issues with bans or technical support. If you have an issue please use the Forum for assistance.
